take: Pittsburgh announced it has placed forwards Bryan Rust and Benjamin Kindel on injured reserve and recalled defenseman Chase Pietila and forward Rutger McGroarty from Wilkes-Barre/Scranton. Rust has three goals and five points in seven games, and he has scored 1.45 more goals than the quality of his chances suggested. Because Kindel, who was next in line for Rust's minutes, is also out, that projection no longer holds. The Penguins are 3-6-1 and have created 47.9 percent of the expected goals this season.
